title: Number of Stable Subsequences
summary: Given an integer array, count the number of subsequences that do not have three consecutive elements with the same parity, and return the count modulo 10^9 + 7.
statement: Given an integer array, count the number of subsequences that do not have three consecutive elements with the same parity, and return the count modulo 10^9 + 7.
constraints: A selected subsequence may not contain three consecutive selected values of one parity.
reference_solution:
def count_stable_subsequences(nums):
    mod=10**9+7;states=[[0,0],[0,0]]
    for value in nums:
        parity=value&1;other=parity^1
        one=(1+states[other][0]+states[other][1])%mod;two=states[parity][0]
        states[parity][0]=(states[parity][0]+one)%mod;states[parity][1]=(states[parity][1]+two)%mod
    return sum(map(sum,states))%mod
